title: Procedure Text
summary: Technical and instructional literacy: analyzing goals, materials, sequence steps, imperative syntax, troubleshooting conditionals, and ensuring procedural safety.

blocks.title: Soal urutan
blocks.question: What should you do right after folding the cardboard?
steps: Cari penanda: Next, fold ... Glue the two ends together ...
Langkah setelah melipat ada di kalimat yang sama.

blocks.question: Which sentence is a typical language feature of a procedure text?

options.B: Stir the mixture for two minutes.
options.C: We visited the museum last week.
options.D: Once upon a time, there was a king.

blocks.explanation: Stir the mixture for two minutes adalah kalimat perintah dengan keterangan waktu.

lessons.title: Imperative Syntax, Action Verbs, and Precise Adverbs of Manner

blocks.html:
Imperative Syntax, Action Verbs, and Precise Adverbs of Manner: Understanding commanding verbs and quantifying measurements (degrees, duration, velocity).

Pelajari konsep melalui representasi visual dan simulasi interaktif di bawah ini untuk memperkuat pemahaman intuisi dan pembuktian prinsip dasar.

blocks.title: Ciri kebahasaan
blocks.html:
• Kalimat perintah (imperative): Cut, Mix, Tap, Do not add ...
  • Penanda urutan: first, next, then, after that, finally.
  • Keterangan cara, waktu, dan jumlah: gently, for fifteen minutes, 100 grams.
  • Peringatan dan syarat: Make sure ..., If ..., Do not ...

blocks.title: Mengurutkan langkah procedure
blocks.caption: Susun langkah-langkah menjadi prosedur yang logis. Pikirkan apa yang harus siap sebelum langkah berikutnya bisa dilakukan.

blocks.title: Soal penerapan (evaluasi)
blocks.question: Your stand keeps sliding on the table. According to the text, what can you do?
steps: Cari bagian yang membahas masalah: If it moves, add a little weight, such as a coin, inside the triangle.
blocks.answer: Put a coin inside the triangle.

blocks.question: What is the purpose of the slot?

options.B: To hold the bottom of the phone
options.C: To let the glue dry faster
options.D: To hang the stand on a wall

blocks.explanation: This slot will hold the bottom of your phone.
